from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Derivatives represent the instantaneous slope of a curve.",
            "Integrals measure the total accumulation of area.",
            "A speedometer measures rate, while an odometer tracks distance."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite Review: The Two Pillars", lecture_lines)
        
        # Create objects
        pillar_a = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.2, height=2, width=1.5, color="#FF9900", fill_opacity=0.5)
        label_a = Text("Differentiation", font_size=24, color="#FF9900")
        pillar_b = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.2, height=2, width=1.5, color="#00CCFF", fill_opacity=0.5)
        label_b = Text("Integration", font_size=24, color="#00CCFF")
        bridge = Line(UP*0.5, DOWN*0.5, color="#FFFFFF").rotate(PI/2)
        label_bridge = Text("Fundamental\nConnection", font_size=18, color="#FFFFFF")

        # Layout
        self.place_at_grid(pillar_a, "B2")
        self.place_at_grid(label_a, "D2")
        self.place_at_grid(pillar_b, "B5")
        self.place_at_grid(label_b, "D5")
        self.place_in_area(bridge, "B3", "B4")
        self.place_at_grid(label_bridge, "C3.5") # Approximated center between B3/B4

        # Animations
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(pillar_a), FadeIn(label_a))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF9900"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(pillar_b), FadeIn(label_b))
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00CCFF"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(Create(bridge), Write(label_bridge))
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))

        # Emphasis
        self.play(Flash(pillar_a, color="#FF9900"), Flash(pillar_b, color="#00CCFF"), Flash(bridge, color="#FFFFFF"))
        self.wait(2)
